name: Crate & Barrel
instructionsEn: There are 3 Ways to Redeem your eGift Card: 1) Online at CrateandBarrel.com, CB2.com, or LandofNod.com. Give the eGift Card number and PIN to the Customer Service associate. 3) Visit a Crate & Barrel, CB2, or The Land of Nod store and display the eGift Card number and PIN to the cashier at the time of purchase. Customer Service Associate: Hand key the eGift Card number and PIN into the POS.
instructionsUrl: Crate & Barrel inspires the modern lifestyle with exclusive furniture and housewares designs that are clean and timeless at an exceptional value. The collection includes original items created in collaboration with designers and artists from around the world, upholstered furniture bench-made at family-owned workshops in North Carolina, eco-friendly collections made of sustainable wood, handloomed wool rugs, and noteworthy wall art curated for each season.

Your acceptance or use of this eGift Card constitutes agreement to these terms and conditions, which may change at any time. To check your balance, visit CrateandBarrel.com/GiftCards or call 877.477.4567. For Customer Service, call 800.606.6458.
